instruction: Access the web extension generator at webext.eu to build a new extension project. Name it "link-saver" with version "0.5.2". Keep description empty. Select background script, content scripts, and page action as the required features, excluding browser action and other options. Save and extract the project archive to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: This task requires using webext.eu to create a Chrome extension with configuration: name 'link-saver', version '0.5.2', empty description, background script, content scripts, and page action (excluding browser_action). The evaluator checks manifest.json for: (1) name='link-saver', (2) version='0.5.2', (3) background scripts present, (4) content_scripts array with entries, (5) page_action configured, (6) description is empty or absent, (7) browser_action is not present. Custom getter reads manifest.json from VM, custom metric validates the structure.
